title:
Transform to set the `hidden` property for the `HPO Configuration` column on the key/additional
hyperparameters grid, based on the `hpoFeatureEnabled` flag.

This transform accepts a json object as input, which is expected to contain the following properties:

columnFields {UiSdlDataGridDataSpecColumnFieldSetting[]}  - Indicates where to locate grid data within the component.
hpoFeatureEnabled {Boolean} - Feature flag for Hyperparameter Optimization.
name: ModelConfigHyperparameterOptimizationColumnFieldsTransform
